content: Ecto optional dep compile pattern: wrap entire defmodule block with 'if Code.ensure_loaded?(Ecto) do'. For migration modules, the Oban pattern is canonical: library defines versioned migrations internally (Oban.Migrations.up/0, down/0), user generates 'mix ecto.gen.migration add_oban' and calls library functions from the up/down callbacks. For schema modules: if Code.ensure_loaded?(Ecto.Schema) do; defmodule MyLib.MySchema do; use Ecto.Schema; schema 'table' do ... end; end; end. The Elixir compiler evaluates 'if Code.ensure_loaded?' at compile time as a compile-time guard since Code.ensure_loaded? runs during compilation. Confirmed: works with full module wrapping, does NOT work wrapping just the 'use' line inside an already-being-compiled module.
